rows.grounds: sandhi of mantraḥ + ayam; nominative demonstrative phrase referring to the mantra
past passive participle of sādh; describes the mantra as perfected through practice
optative form of dā; expresses potential result of the accomplished mantra
compound iṣṭa-siddhim; object denoting fulfillment of what is wished
form of nṛ; indicates those for whom the accomplishment is granted
indeclinable adverb; affirms the certainty of the result
